$comment: Do-not-translate terms for the build-time DeepL pipeline (scripts/translate.mjs and scripts/lib/richtext-translate.mjs, via scripts/lib/deepl.mjs). Each term is protected verbatim through translation. Matching is CASE-SENSITIVE and bounded to whole tokens, longest term first. URLs and email addresses are protected automatically by pattern in deepl.mjs and do NOT need to be listed here. ICU placeholders ({name}, {count, plural, …}) and Lingui/HTML component tags (<0>, </0>, <strong>) are likewise auto-protected. CITY EXONYMS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED HERE: this is a do-not-translate list, so listing "Berlin" forced the English form into locales that localize it (es Berlín, it Berlino, pt Berlim) while de and fr use "Berlin" natively — which is why the wrong entry went unnoticed for so long. Do not re-add it. scripts/new-post.mjs will re-offer it as a glossary candidate on the next post that mentions the city; decline. Legal/postal addresses are safe either way: they are bare JSX in src/pages/Legal.tsx, outside <Trans>, so lingui never extracts them and the translator never sees them.
